name: Chatbot by Ohsembot
author: Shahril Haniff

sections.description:
Chatbot by Ohsembot helps WordPress site owners add an AI-powered chat experience without a complicated setup process.

The plugin can bootstrap a demo chatbot for quick testing, then lets you connect your own OhSemBot-generated runtime package when you are ready to move to a fully customized deployment.

It is designed for site owners who want a simple path from initial evaluation to a production-ready chatbot experience on WordPress.

Key Features

  • Quick-start demo chatbot setup for faster onboarding.
  • Secure WordPress widget token flow for frontend requests.
  • Admin settings for API base URL, chatbot ID, API key, and theme.
  • One-click path to upgrade from the demo flow to a custom OhSemBot chatbot package.
  • WordPress-friendly script loading and admin integration.

External Service Notice

This plugin connects to the OhSemBot service to bootstrap demo chatbot access, refresh widget tokens, and support custom chatbot deployments.

Service website:
https://www.ohsembot.com/

Before using the plugin in production, review the service terms, privacy policy, and account requirements provided by OhSemBot.

Benefits

  • Add an AI chatbot experience to your site with minimal setup.
  • Keep sensitive token refresh logic on the server side instead of exposing credentials to browser JavaScript.
  • Start with a guided setup and move to a branded chatbot when your account and configuration are ready.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chatbot-by-ohsembot/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Chatbot by Ohsembot menu in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Review the setup guidance shown on the plugin page.
  5. Configure the widget settings if needed, including API Base URL, Chatbot ID, API Key, and Theme.
  6. Save your settings and confirm the chatbot loads correctly on the frontend.
  7. Optional: Upload your generated custom OhSemBot runtime package to replace the demo chatbot flow.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OhSemBot account to use this plugin?

You can start with the plugin’s guided demo flow, but a full custom deployment requires an OhSemBot account and a generated custom runtime package.

Does this plugin connect to an external service?

Yes. The plugin connects to OhSemBot for demo bootstrap requests, widget token refresh, and custom chatbot-related functionality.

How do I replace the demo chatbot with my own chatbot?

Create and configure your chatbot in OhSemBot, generate the WordPress plugin package from your account, then upload that package through the plugin’s upgrade section in WordPress.
